messages.灰色の弾丸5で資源を払わずに撃ち、充電・呼吸・沈潜を積んで貫通火力を出す、7枠広: A 7-target WAW Pride E.G.O that fires without paying resources at 5 Ashen Bullet and stacks Charge, Poise, and Sinking to deal Pierce damage.
messages.灰色の弾丸: パッシブにより、弾丸が5なら資源を消費せずに撃てる。ターン開始時に: **Ashen Bullet**: Through the passive, it can be fired without spending resources at 5 Bullets. Bullets increase by 1 at Turn Start. If short, he can pay SP before attacking to top them up to the maximum.
messages.再使用される1コイン目: 破壊不能で、メインターゲットにだけ的中する。弾丸を消耗: **Reused first Coin**: Unbreakable and only hits the main target. It spends Bullets and is reused as long as Bullets remain, up to 4 times per skill. In practice, it can be treated as a single-target attack.
messages.充電・呼吸・黒い翼: 攻撃前に呼吸威力と充電を得て、(呼吸威力+充電)と弾丸でマ: **Charge, Poise, and Black Wings**: Before attacking, he gains Poise Potency and Charge, and (Poise Potency + Charge) and Bullets raise Clash Power. Black Wings increase Charge and Offense Level at Turn Start.
messages.沈潜と貫通脆弱: 1コイン目の的中時に貫通脆弱と沈潜を付与し、2コイン目で沈潜回: **Sinking and Pierce Fragility**: The first Coin inflicts Pierce Fragility and Sinking on hit, and the second Coin increases Sinking Count.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 2コイン目の裏面確率は弾丸×20%で、弾丸が5なら確実に裏面。表面: **Corrosion skill**: The second Coin's chance of Tails is Bullets×20%, guaranteeing Tails at 5 Bullets. On Heads, the attack does not hit.
messages.弾丸を5にして撃ち、資源の負担なしで高火力を出す。弾丸が足りないときは精神力を払: Fire it at 5 Bullets to deal heavy damage with no resource burden. When short on Bullets, pay SP to make up the difference.
messages.呼吸と充電を事前に積んでから撃つと、威力とクリティカルがさらに伸びる。: Building Poise and Charge before firing further raises its power and Critical Hits.
messages.1コイン目が単体向けなので、狙う敵を決めて撃つ。広域部分は巻き込み分の火力になる: The first Coin is single-target, so decide which enemy to aim at. The multi-target part is extra damage on the enemies caught in it.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が12になり、クリティカル強化と、攻撃対象1名のときのダメージ量増: **Ⅲ**: Base Power becomes 12, and the Critical bonus and the damage increase against a single target are added.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+2になり、対象1名時の増加が100%に、充電によるコイン威力: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power becomes +2, the single-target increase becomes 100%, and Charge-based Coin Power is added.
messages.南部ディエーチ協会4課部長: 沈潜を付与するスキルを持ち、このE.G.Oの沈潜付: **[Dieci Assoc. South Section 4 Director](persona:0510)**: Has skills that inflict Sinking, so a Sinking-centered team can stack it with this E.G.O's Sinking.
messages.西部センク協会3課: 貫通スキルで呼吸を得て、呼吸威力が積みやすい。: **[Cinq Assoc. West Section 3](persona:0511)**: Gains Poise with his Pierce skills, making Poise Potency easy to build.
